h: The Two Colors of Wine and the Future of Mercy

p: and corresponding to the two colors of wine
וּלְמַעְלָה (חֵלֶק ג רטז, סוֹף עַמּוּד ב)
white from the side of the right,
red from the side of the left, etc."
That is, with Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
from the side of the right, the aspect of Chessed.
"the Great One of the worlds was there";
וְזֶה מְרַמֵּז עַל בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and this alludes to the aspect of the Oral Torah,
which is called "the Torah of kindness on her tongue."
and this is the meaning of "the Great One of the worlds":
that it is above the grasp of the human intellect,
And red wine, from the side of the left,
as it is written, "And he brought him wine, and he drank";
and it alludes to the "fiery law"
that is in the wine of Torah;
"This young Torah scholar who boils with anger:
it is the Torah that makes him boil,
And this is why it says:
"and corresponding to the two colors of wine
שֶׁאָמַר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג רכד, א)
what is said in the holy Zohar (this parshah, III 224a):
'zechirah' in the male, in the brain, etc.";
along the lines of "Zachor for the male
That is, Binah is the heart,
and in the heart there are two hearts,
the heart of the wise and the heart of the fool;
and for this guarding is needed:
there is the soul that is in the brain:
"the soul that You placed within me is pure";
therefore it says "the male, in the brain."
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קעה, ב)
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (II 175b):
"And supernal Chessed issues from Chochmah, etc.";
that is, Chochmah is the brain;
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב יד, סוֹף עַמּוּד ב)
And in the holy Zohar (II, end of 14b):
"He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah,
Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah, etc."
And this is "corresponding to the two colors of wine,"
which is Chochmah, thought, the brain,
Shamor, which is Binah, the heart,

p: וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (חֵלֶק ג רמב, א)
And in the holy Zohar on this parshah (III 242a):
"'Your Kohanim shall be clothed in righteousness' (Tehillim 132:9):
for righteousness is from the side of the Levites;
'and Your pious ones shall sing for joy':
for song and melody are from the Levites;
and said 'Your Kohanim' and 'Your pious ones,'
who are from the side of the right.
The Holy One, blessed is He, said to him:
David, this is not My way.
'For the sake of David Your servant,
do not turn away the face of Your anointed':
the arrangement that I have arranged,
And it needs to be understood:
why indeed did David change the order,
so that he had to ask,
"do not turn away the face of Your anointed"?
And why did he not say,
"Your Levites shall be clothed in righteousness and sing for joy,"
according to the way and order of Hashem Yisbarach?
is judgment from the side of the left,
from the side of the Levites,
"And if I am a master, where is My fear?"
to the attribute of Gevurah and restraint,
the aspect of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
as we said the explanation of
(and it was explained in the previous maamar);
and "the meal of the Field of Apples"
הוּא נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
whose attribute is the Fear of Yitzchak;
and this is in This World.
But for the Time to Come we find,
as derived from what is said,
on the day Yitzchak was weaned,"
that the Holy One, blessed is He, will in the future
make a feast for the tzaddikim
on the day He bestows kindness
And this is according to what is written
in the holy Zohar on this parshah
and I am read with Adnus;
but in the World to Come
to be mercy from every side."
That is, even the Name Adnus
will be from the side of the right,
And David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
and that the complete rectification come about;
"Your Kohanim shall be clothed in righteousness,
and Your pious ones shall sing for joy,"
so that the aspect of Tzedek too
be from the side of the right,
as it will be in the Time to Come;
"do not turn away the face of Your anointed":
And indeed, from the attribute of Malchus,
although it is the aspect of judgment,
בָּא מִמֶּנּוּ גַּם הַשָּׂכָר טוֹב לַצַּדִּיקִים
comes also the good reward for the tzaddikim,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב צא, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 91a):
that there is judgment and there is a Judge,
a good reward for the tzaddikim, etc.;
for its secret is the lower hei."
And so it is in the Midrash
with these and with those, etc.;
"And from where do we know that the reward of the tzaddikim
that You have hidden away for those who fear You,
although it is the attribute of Malchus,
יֵשׁ בּוֹ הֶאָרָה מֵאוֹר הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁנִּגְנַז
there is in it an illumination of the primordial light that was hidden,
as is written in Sefer HaBahir:
and placed it for them in its stead,
and the rest He hid away for the tzaddikim, etc."
